newsitem.title: FRANCE: France urges nationals to quit Albania.
newsitem.headline: France urges nationals to quit Albania.

text.p: France on Monday urged its nationals living in Albania to leave the country and advised any would-be travellers planning to visit the country to stay away.
In a statement, the foreign ministry said that "those whose presence (in Albania) is not indispensible" should return to France.
A state of emergency and nationwide curfew came into force throughout Albania on Monday as parliament elected President Sali Berisha to a second five-year term in office.
The election took place a day after the parliament voted unanimously to declare an immediate state of emergency in response to armed unrest in the south of the Balkan country.
